findings_or_gaps: Missing required e2e runner: `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` contains only the five individual probes (`:168`, `:302`, `:465`, `:635`, `:904`). It does not provide the acceptance-criterion runner that executes all 5 probes together, prints a summary report, logs structured traces, and exits non-zero on violation.

Failure diagnostics are incomplete for mechanistic assertion failures. The probe file uses raw `assert!` checks before `run.finish()` (for example `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:238-263`, `:809-858`, `:991-1014`), but `HarnessRun` only writes trace/artifact output inside `finish()` (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:634-715`). If one of those assertions trips, the run aborts without the A2d trace artifacts the bead asked for.

The biofilter scaling probe does not currently verify the promised 'bigger media -> higher nitrifier capacity -> faster cycling' story. At `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:244-263` it only checks that both runs exceed a minimum nitrifier biomass. The observed passing run had the 2x-media tank with slightly worse TAN and lower nitrifier biomass, so this probe can pass while the intended behavior regresses.
follow_up_or_amendments: Add an aggregate habitat/geometry summary test modeled on the carbonate/conservation suites so one entrypoint runs all five probes, prints a readable report, emits structured traces, and fails the job when any probe violates its envelope.

Route probe checks through harness-recorded failures (or catch panics and force artifact emission) so any failing scenario still writes `metadata.json`, `checkpoints.json`, `budget_ledger.json`, and `trace.jsonl` for diagnosis.

Strengthen the biofilter probe so it actually asserts a cycling/capacity outcome under a media-limited workload, such as lower peak TAN/NO2, faster ammonia clearance, or earlier maturity in the larger-media run.
